overview.text: 四 means ‘four.’ Its current form encloses inner strokes within 囗. Its origin is disputed: it may be a direct numeral graph or a graph later borrowed for ‘four’; the proposed borrowing accounts remain unproven.

components.text: 囗 forms the enclosing outer shape in the present graph.
儿 identifies the inner strokes in the present graph; their ancient role is unresolved.
